title: The coordinate-tower counit square under arbitrary Noetherian base change
statement: For normalized projective-line data satisfying its base-change square, the actual composite affine-space counit at every coefficient complex K commutes with the coordinatewise pasted exchange and canonical right-functor base-change comparison, in every dimension, as stated in the Lean attachment.

proof.text: Induct on dimension: identity at zero; at a successor apply counit naturality to the previous right comparison, use the line square, then tower-exchange naturality and the preceding counit square. Functor map composition and associativity give exactly the displayed equality.

proof_origin.place: Generic ordered counit-pasting induction, followed by specialization to the affine coordinate categories.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTraceTowerCounit_baseChange (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (hD : OrdinaryFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t D)
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S'] [IsNoetherian S]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    affineTraceExchange A g d ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj K) ≫
        (affineTraceLeft A S' d).map
          (affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t g hS d K).hom ≫
        (affineTraceAdjunction A N hA t D S'
          (affineTracePullbackInvertible N g hS) d).counit.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A g).obj K) =
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map
        ((affineTraceAdjunction A N hA t D S hS d).counit.app K)
